description: This file defines a Worksheet iterator class for the PhpSpreadsheet library, enabling iteration over worksheets within a spreadsheet object.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: A class implementing PHP's Iterator interface to facilitate traversing worksheets in a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a Spreadsheet object to iterate over its worksheets.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator position to the beginning.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current Worksheet object based on the iterator's position.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current position index of the iterator.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next worksheet.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid (i.e., within the worksheet count).
